titre: Puces d'étiquettes radio expédiées dans le monde
sous_titre: Milliards de puces expédiées par les fabricants, 2023 à 2025

2023.texte: shipments of RAIN tag chips reaching record volumes of 45.5bn units in 2023

2024.texte: 52.8bn RAIN tag chips / ICs were shipped globally in 2024, as reported by five of its leading tag manufacturer members

2025.texte: In 2025, those four companies shipped 42.7 billion RAIN tag chips globally.
